decisions.reason: The award-winning hipress probe exceeds aspirations and fits the growing geothermal heat-pump market, so a large firm like Jansen has every reason to keep it.
The single-U probe is a standard complement within the established geothermal line, and in a strong heat-pump market there is no shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
The surface technology supports the geothermal probe range and costs little to carry with available slack, although its stand-alone results are less visible.
Fire-protection steel profiles are a core, regulation-driven segment of Jansen's steel systems business with steady demand, so performance likely meets aspirations.
Slim steel profile systems match architectural demand and form part of the established profile portfolio, giving no reason to divert resources.
The decorative surface system is a more niche add-on with uncertain results, but the firm's slack and low carrying costs justify keeping it for now.
